title: Critique: mind acting on body would violate the conservation of energy

statements.text: Mind-body interaction seems to require causal power flowing into and out of the body in a way that conflicts with the conservation of energy, a fundamental law, and of momentum. The principle is widely taken to be a serious difficulty for interactionist dualism, whether of substances or properties.
